verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no marketplace or catalog of third-party datasets. MotherDuck documents public Shares that anyone with a MotherDuck account in the same cloud region can attach, plus an example of attaching a hacker_news share. That is an adjacent sharing mechanism, not a dataset marketplace with listings, discovery, or third-party providers, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an analyst, a marketplace of third-party datasets lets me enrich my own data directly inside the platform
